description: Set the default object styles for new text and graphic frames, the default paragraph and character styles for new text, and whether applying an object style always clears overrides (Default Text Frame Style, Default Graphic Frame Style, Clear Overrides When Applying Style); returns the current defaults

characterStyle.description: Character style new text gets: a style name, or "Group/Style" for a style inside a style group

clearOverridesWhenApplying.description: Clear Overrides When Applying Style (an application preference)

graphicFrameStyle.description: Object style new graphic frames get: a style name, or "Group/Style" for a style inside a style group

paragraphStyle.description: Paragraph style new text gets: a style name, or "Group/Style" for a style inside a style group

textFrameStyle.description: Object style new text frames get: a style name, or "Group/Style" for a style inside a style group

name: set_style_defaults
title: Set Style Defaults
